question: Did Plexus's fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 4, 2026) revenue, GAAP diluted EPS and non-GAAP (adjusted) operating margin land above, within or below the ranges the company guided to in its fiscal Q2 earnings release on April 29, 2026?
grading: Key points: (1) revenue USD 1.305B (1,304.8M) vs guidance USD 1.200-1.250B = ABOVE; (2) GAAP diluted EPS USD 1.58 vs USD 1.25-1.41 = ABOVE; (3) adjusted (non-GAAP) operating margin 6.3% vs 5.9%-6.3% = WITHIN (at the high end, which management described as 'met the high end'); optional: adjusted EPS USD 2.32 vs 2.02-2.18 = ABOVE, GAAP operating margin 4.7% vs 4.1%-4.5% = ABOVE. Benchmark must be company guidance (April 29, 2026), not consensus. Fail if the margin is called above range, or any metric is called below range.
answer: Against the Q3 FY2026 guidance in the April 29, 2026 release [H17-E1], Plexus's results for the quarter ended July 4, 2026 [H17-E2][H17-E3] were: revenue USD 1.305 billion (net sales USD 1,304.8 million) vs USD 1.200-1.250 billion = above (about 4.4% over the top end); GAAP diluted EPS USD 1.58 vs USD 1.25-1.41 = above; non-GAAP (adjusted) operating margin 6.3% vs 5.9%-6.3% = within, at the high end. Also above: adjusted EPS USD 2.32 vs USD 2.02-2.18 and GAAP operating margin 4.7% vs 4.1%-4.5%.

output.answer:
## Plexus Fiscal Q3 2026 vs. Guidance

**Short answer: Revenue — above; GAAP diluted EPS — above; non-GAAP (adjusted) operating margin — within (at the high end).**

### Guidance issued April 29, 2026 (Q2 FY26 release, for Q3 ending July 4, 2026)
| Metric | Guidance Range |
|---|---|
| Revenue | $1.200B – $1.250B |
| GAAP diluted EPS | $1.25 – $1.41 |
| Non-GAAP operating margin | 5.9% – 6.3% |

*(For context, guidance also included GAAP operating margin of 4.1%–4.5% and non-GAAP EPS of $2.02–$2.18.)*

### Actual Q3 FY26 results (reported July 29, 2026)
| Metric | Actual | vs. Guidance |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $1.305B | **Above** (~$55M above high end; +12% Q/Q, +28% Y/Y) |
| GAAP diluted EPS | $1.58 | **Above** (above the $1.41 high end) |
| Non-GAAP operating margin | 6.3% | **Within** (at the top of the 5.9%–6.3% range) |

Operating income was $61.3M on GAAP basis (4.7% margin, above the 4.1%–4.5% guide), and non-GAAP diluted EPS came in at $2.32, also above its $2.02–$2.18 guide. Management attributed the beats to better-than-expected performance in all three market sectors (aerospace/defense, healthcare/life sciences, industrial), program ramps, and revenue leverage.

- Plexus Q3 FY26 earnings release (results): https://investor.plexus.com/news/news-details/2026/Plexus-Announces-Fiscal-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx | GlobeNewswire: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/29/3335595/0/en/plexus-announces-fiscal-third-quarter-financial-results.html
